purpose: Full-bank production-marker regression on all school-mock-tagged Physics, Chemistry and Year 1 Pure Maths flashcards, keeping original IDs/progress, correct/wrong variants, and a length heuristic distinguishing flashcards from long answers.
notes: Additional adversarial regression: prefix each complete correct model answer with 'not' and require a wrong mark, including all 3,382 school-mock-tagged cards.
Tests actual production answer evaluator and applies all patch functions up to v332 to original deck.
Explicit accepted/rejected lists are test fixtures; correct responses never seen before may still need human calibration.
Length thresholds are simple regression alarms, not proof that every card is semantically well written.
Original multi-mark exam questions remain in separate practice banks; never force them into flashcards.
Full AQA bullet-level coverage certification and open-ended unseen-answer review remain unfinished.
